statement: For a p-parameter real function class whose threshold predicate is uniformly expressible by a polynomial first-order formula with fixed K quantifier blocks of dimensions d_1,...,d_K, at most M atomic polynomials, and degree at most Delta, Pdim(F) is O(p*prod_k(d_k+1)*log(M) + p^2*prod_k(d_k)*log(Delta)).
quantifiers: For every class F and every x,t satisfying the uniform FOL representation assumptions.
accepted_primary_lemmas: Basu-Pollack-Roy (2006), Algorithm 14.8 quantifier-elimination complexity, as stated in paper Theorem 2.5
Bartlett-Indyk-Wagner (2022), Theorem 3.3 GJ pseudo-dimension bound, as stated in paper Appendix Theorem A.3
verification_target: Independently reconstruct and mechanically check the asymptotic implication from the two accepted lemmas to the displayed Theorem 4.1 bound.
non_circularity: No sample size, numerical horizon, tolerance, or target-derived query budget is used; this is a symbolic proof certificate.
